changes: Native Slang 2026 module with explicit public APIs; original s2h_* names retained.
Gather, embedded font, 3D geometry and Scatter moved into separate module implementation files.
S2H_VERSION is an exported typed constant; caller macros no longer configure the library.
Scatter uses ContextScatter<TSink : IScatterSink>; table, plot and scene callbacks use constrained generic interfaces.
Embedded 8x8 font is fixed; legacy GLSL/font-replacement macros are not module configuration.
Original HLSL snapshot removed after successful GPU comparison; only the native Slang implementation is distributed.

upstreamFilesNote: Historical hashes of the source revision used for this port; original HLSL files are not distributed in this repository.
